parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing strengths dominate: no criminalisation since 1971, no entry/visa policy targeting LGBTQ travellers, administrative gender recognition (2018 decree), state-funded transition care, strong hate-crime penalties, and unusually supportive official posture (presidential apology, pride participation, flag). No documented border friction, facility bans, or police targeting of trans visitors; police raids are described as historical. Deductions: enforcement of the 2020 hate-crime provisions is undocumented; 2025 rollbacks (sex-ed, anti-bullying protocol) signal backsliding climate; society is divided (religious opposition, contentious 2018 election). Custody placement failures (trans woman in men's facility, abuse witnessed by custodian) are tier-4 if reached, but are resident-facing, low-probability for a visitor, and accompanied by a genuine choice policy. No universal-exposure measure or organised targeting is documented.
